name: GenerateSecretKey
description: Gets a secure key value for use in the encrypt function.

params.name: algorithm
params.description:
The encryption algorithm for which to generate the key.

The available algorithms (depending on your JVM) are 

- HmacSHA3-224
- HmacSHA384
- HmacSHA512/224
- HmacSHA512
- HmacSHA512/256
- HmacSHA3-512
- HmacSHA3-256
- HmacSHA3-384
- HmacSHA224
- ARCFOUR
- Blowfish
- HmacSHA256
- HmacSHA1
- AES
- HmacMD5
- DESede
- DES
- RC2
- ChaCha20

params.name: keySize
params.description: Number of bits requested in the key for the specified algorithm.
